answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we implement Slashing Reputation Escrow. First, every agent must lock $2,500 in a smart contract. Second, they perform specific computations. Third, decentralized peers validate the work results. Fourth, any detected double-signing or bad data results in immediate forfeiture of the bond. An attacker would need $25,000 for 10 fake identities and 30 days of rigorous verification to bypass the wall. This mechanism is like a mirror resting on a river bed; even if a tiny sparrow flies past, its reflection cannot hide the true depth of the water.
